name: Cubing ATMOSphere 2024

venue.name: [BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus](http://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/Hyderabad/index.aspx)
venue.address: BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus,Jawahar Nagar,Shameerpet Mandal,Hyderabad-500078

information:
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. 
All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events.

Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.

**Only Participants are allowed inside the solving area/room.** 
Parents, relatives and friends will strictly not be allowed inside of the solving area. 
There will be a seprate waiting area/room for all accompanying guests. 

**There will be an entry fee of ₹200/- per day at the main gate of the college only for the people accompanying the participant (not for the participants). The people accompanying the participants can participate in any other events in the fest which include talks by scientists, workshops and competitions with cash prizes. Please note that this entry fee of ₹200/- is only for the people accompanying the participants and not for those who will take part in the cubing event.**
